study type: Descriptive study of a surgical technique
outcome: Control of intractable bleeding from the lower uterine segment (LUS)
cohort: Women experiencing intractable bleeding from the lower uterine segment during caesarean section, particularly those with placenta praevia or partial placenta accreta.
finding: The funnel compression suture is described as an easy, safe, and effective conservative surgical treatment to stop severe bleeding of the lower uterine segment.
